1 (By Sri Viranagouda M.Biradar, AGA)
 This writ petition is filed under Articles 226 and 227 of the Constitution of India praying to issue a writ in the nature of the mandamus, thereby directing the respondents No.1 and 2 to consider the objection filed by the petitioner to notice issued under Section 15 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 vide Annexure-E and direct them not to initiate acquisition proceedings in respect of petition land.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
This petition coming on for Preliminary Hearing, this day, the court made the following:-
 ORDER Learned Additional Government Advocate accepts notice on behalf of respondents.
2. It is the case of the petitioners that in terms of Annexure-B, the only land of the petitioner measuring 01 acre 96 guntas is sought to be acquired by the Government.

Aggrieved by the same,
the representations are given by the petitioners as per Annexures-C and E.
The representations dated 11.01.2021 and 21.06.2022 are not yet considered by the respondents.

3. Under these circumstances, a direction is issued to the respondents to consider the representations of the petitioners at Annexures-C and E within a period of three months from the date of receipt of copy of this order and appropriate decision taken on the endorsement shall be communicated to the petitioners.
4.
It is expected that the respondents shall strictly adhere to the time line fixed by this court to avoid possible contempt petition for non-compliance of the order within the time frame fixed.
